default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1018.title: Rolling z-score band fade
E-1018.hypothesis: A close more than k standard deviations from its own rolling mean is a stretched, mostly liquidity-driven move; the other side is momentum chasers who get faded back toward the mean.

E-1019.title: Session-open recross follow
E-1019.hypothesis: After trading on one side of the session open price for a while, a close back through it flips the day's winners and losers: those holding the old side must cover, so follow the cross.

E-1020.title: Bar-colour share exhaustion fade
E-1020.hypothesis: When most bars of a window share one colour the move is crowded; buyers or sellers are spent and the first cross of the share threshold marks a fade point.

E-1022.title: US-open volume surge follow
E-1022.hypothesis: Around the US cash open a heavy-volume bar closing near its extreme shows large institutional flow arriving; slower participants chase in its direction.

E-1023.title: Rolling VWAP and session VWAP agreement
E-1023.hypothesis: A close crossing above both the short-window volume-weighted price and the session VWAP means recent and day-long buyers are in profit together; follow the alignment.

E-1024.title: Autocorrelation regime bar trade
E-1024.hypothesis: Return autocorrelation shifts between trending and mean-reverting tapes; when the recent lag-1 autocorrelation is positive follow large bars, when negative fade them.

E-1025.title: Higher-high streak failure
E-1025.hypothesis: After a streak of consecutive higher highs, a bar that fails to extend and closes below the prior low shows late buyers trapped; trade the reversal.

E-1026.title: EMA fan alignment onset
E-1026.hypothesis: When three EMAs line up in order with the close beyond the fastest, a trend has just become orderly; trend followers join as the alignment forms.

E-1027.title: Volatility expansion direction follow
E-1027.hypothesis: When the last three bars' average range jumps well above the recent base, new information is being priced; the net direction of those bars tends to continue.

E-1021.title: Index leads the dollar
E-1021.hypothesis: The index and the dollar are negatively related; when the index moves strongly and the dollar has not yet reacted, slower dollar participants catch up in the opposite direction.
